name: engineering-focus
description: Vendor-neutral engineering-agent behavior for bounded execution, context discipline, deterministic validation, structured handoffs, and measured efficiency.

interface.longDescription: Apply bounded task execution, relevant-context discipline, deterministic validation, reusable artifacts, explicit stop conditions, structured handoffs, and selectable strict, balanced, exploratory, or disabled behavior.
defaultPrompt: Use engineering-focus in BALANCED mode for this task.
Use engineering-focus STRICT mode and validate completion.
Use engineering-focus EXPLORATORY mode to generate alternatives, then recommend focused validation.
